crossRefs.note: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…
May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and…
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and…
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and…
Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”
Behold, all those who are incensed against you will be disappointed and confounded. Those who strive with you will be…
But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one. Therefore my persecutors will stumble, and they won’t prevail. They…
Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…

translations.web: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.
translations.bsb: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
translations.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
translations.asv: Let them be put to shame and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor that seek my hurt.
